TestSSTableGenerationAndLoading::test_pr.description: Single node, enable_cache=false. Table with static column; writes a tiny partition (pk=1, static only) then a 2000-row partition (pk=0), restarts node (memtable flushed on shutdown) and reads one clustering row of pk=0 from sstable. Guards scylla#1567: KL writer did not reset block_first_colname after a partition without promoted-index entry, producing a bad promoted index offset for the next partition -> parse error on read. Only real assertion: one row returned.

origin.summary: Tomasz Grabiec: add test for promoted index generation (scylla#1567), sent by mail alongside scylla fix f1c2481040.

TestSSTableGenerationAndLoading::test_pr.relevance: Bug was in the KL sstable writer (sstables.cc maybe_flush_pi_block, fixed scylla f1c2481040). KL writer removed in scylla c7096470bf (2021-03-31, 'sstables: remove unused KL writer'); writable formats now md/me/ms/mt (db/config.cc sstable_format). With the compact mc+ row format, 2000 small rows (~40KB) likely stay under default column_index_size_in_kb=64, so a promoted index may not even be generated for pk=0.

TestSSTableGenerationAndLoading::test_in.description: Single node, table created via create_cf(compression='Deflate') (dtest_class.py:348, sets sstable_compression DeflateCompressor). Writes 10 cells of hex(os.urandom(5000)) into one partition, flushes, sleeps 2s, reads c < '8' and asserts result non-empty. Inherited from Cassandra dtest; guards CASSANDRA-3370 (Deflate compression of incompressible data producing bad/oversized sstable).

TestSSTableGenerationAndLoading::test_re.description: Single node, c-s writes 10k rows, flush+compact, stop. (1) Removes *Summary.db, restarts, asserts all rows identical (summary regenerated). (2) For each of Index, Filter, Statistics, Digest.*, Partitions, Rows (if present) moves the component away, starts node (no_wait) and waits for malformed_sstable_exception / 'Startup failed' (Digest: also accepts CQL up, missing digest tolerated since 2026.2), kills node, asserts Data.db still exists, restores component. (3) Restarts and asserts all rows identical. Uses abort_on_malformed_sstable_error=False. Guards that scylla rejects an incomplete sstable without deleting data (dtest#842, CASSANDRA-343 origin).

origin.summary: Cassandra dtest origin; scylla rework by Benny Halevy in PR #850 (2019-02, fixes dtest#842): summary regeneration, per-component malformed detection, data verification.
